Date March 12, 1938.

（印：SECRET）

Subject (in full) New Publicity Agency of the proposed Central China
Government.

Made by ... and ... Forwarded by Inspector Papp

* See also
D 8149/F 31

According to information received, a certain
news agency called the Associated China Press (中華聯合新聞社)
has recently been established in Shanghai, which is reported
to be the publicity agency of the proposed Central China
Government.

The address of the new agency is not yet known.

S 5

（印：... B ... 12 MAR 1938 ...）

E. Papp
Inspector

S.1, Special Branch.
REPORT
File MUNICIPAL POLICE
D. REGISTRY
8374
5 3 38
Date March 4, 19 38.

Subject Chung Hwa United News Agency - Further Report.

Made by D.S.I. Kao Yen-ken Forwarded by C. Crawford. D. I.

Further to the report dated March 2 on the subject
of the formation of the Chung Hwa United News Agency, Room 509,
20 Canton Road, enquiries show that the office was established
under the auspices of Mr. Liang Hung-ta (梁鴻志), a Fokienese,
formerly Chief Secretary to the late Tuan Chi-shui (段祺瑞),
once Chief Executive of the Peking Regime, and at present
nominated for the post of Prime Minister for the scheduled
"Central China Government". The necessary funds for running
the news agency are being supplied through the preparatory
office of the "Central China Government" in the New Asia
Hotel, Tiendong Road, by a Formosan named Wong ( 王 ).
It is predicted that the agency will later serve as
the mouthpiece for the "Central China Government", but for
the time being, it will confine its activities to the
publication of news devoid of propaganda and to the suborning
of the leading Chinese journalists in Shanghai. With
regard to the latter part of the programme, it is learned
that the agency has already secured the services of Mr. Woo
Ta-bing (吳之屏), Chief of the News Collection Department
of the Sin Wan Pao, 274 Hankow Road, and Mr. Chao Soh-yung
(趙叔雍), Chief of the News Collection Department of the
now defunct Shun Pao. The ultimate object of the agency,
it is reported, is the monopoly of all news and information
in Shanghai.

（左侧印章：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH - 5 MAR. 1938）
（左侧手写批注：cp. 1/3 DC (G)）

8374

日期：1938年3月4日。

事由：中华联合新闻社——进一步报告。

由特务副督察高延根（Kao Yen-ken）制作，由克劳福德（C. Crawford）侦探督察转呈。

继3月2日关于中华联合新闻社组建情况的报告之后，经查询显示，该办事处是在梁鸿志先生的支持下成立的。梁氏为福建人，曾任已故段祺瑞的首席秘书，段氏曾任北京政府执政，目前被提名为预定成立的“华中政府”总理一职。运营该新闻社所需的资金，正通过位于天潼路新亚酒店的“华中政府”筹备办公室，由一名姓王（Wong）的台湾人提供。据预测，该社日后将充当“华中政府”的喉舌，但目前其活动仅限于发布不含宣传色彩的新闻，以及收买上海的主要中国记者。关于后一项计划，据悉该社已争取到汉口路274号《新闻报》采访部主任吴之屏先生，以及现已停刊的《申报》采访部主任赵叔雍先生的服务。据报道，该社的最终目的是垄断上海的所有新闻和信息。

（左侧印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处特务科 - 1938年3月5日）
（左侧手写批注：抄送 1/3 副总监 (G)）

抄送 E. 档案 高延根
特务副督察
573.

page_data.en:
Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers :-
THE CHINA UNITED NEWS AGENCY
The China United News Agency (中華聯合通訊社)
will begin to issue news sheets in a few days.
At 6 p.m. yesterday, the agency enter-
tained newspapermen at the Dah Si Yang Restaurant on Foochow
Road. Some 20 persons were present. Mr. Zung Shou-nyi
(鄭守彝), the publisher and editor, spoke on the policy
to be followed by the agency. The party terminated at 9 p.m.
page_data.zh:
《新闻报》及其他本地报纸：
中华联合通讯社
中华联合通讯社（中華聯合通訊社）将于数日后开始发布新闻稿。
昨日下午6时，该社在福州路大西洋西菜馆宴请报界人士。出席者约20人。出版人兼编辑郑守彝先生讲话，阐述了该社将遵循的方针。聚会于晚上9时结束。

S. D. REGISTRY

REPORT
Date March 2, 1938.

Subject (in full) Chung Hwa United News Agency - commences functioning on
March 1, 1938.

Made by D.S.I. Kao Yen-ken Forwarded by C. Crawford 2/3

A news agency to be known as the "Chung Hwa United
News Agency" (中華聯合通訊社) has commenced functioning
since March 1, in Room 509, N.K.K. Building, 20 Canton Road.
It publishes, in the Chinese language, news on the general
political situation.

The publisher and editor of the agency is Mr. Tei
Shu-gi (鄭守義), a Japanese subject. He is assisted by
the following Chinese journalists :-
Mr. Wong Si-zung (王西神) of the Sin Wen Pao,
274 Hankow Road.
Mr. Yu Dah-yung (余大雄), formerly attached to
the "Crystal", 299 Hankow Road.
Mr. Sung Tung-wu (孫東吳) of the "Crystal",
299 Hankow Road.

It is learned that this establishment is supported by the
"Central China Government", and further enquiries are
proceeding in this connection.

（左侧批注：SS / m4 / CP. 1/3 / D.C.(d) / （印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH - 2 MAR. 1938 M.B.））

日期：1938年3月2日。

事由（全称）：中华联合新闻社——于1938年3月1日开始运作。

由特务副督察高延根（Kao Yen-ken）制作，由克劳福德（C. Crawford）于2/3转呈

一家名为“中华联合新闻社”（中華聯合通訊社）的新闻社自3月1日起在广东路20号北康康大楼（N.K.K. Building）509室开始运作。该社以中文发布有关一般政治局势的新闻。

该社的出版人兼编辑为日本籍人士郑守义（Tei Shu-gi）。他得到以下中国记者的协助：
汉口路274号《新闻报》的王西神先生。
前任职于汉口路299号《晶报》的余大雄先生。
汉口路299号《晶报》的孙东吴先生。

据悉，该机构由“华中政府”支持，目前正在就此进行进一步调查。
